breaking_news.headline: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
breaking_news.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.

breaking_news.headline: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
breaking_news.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
breaking_news.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

breaking_news.headline: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
breaking_news.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

breaking_news.headline: Should you trust new AI agents with your money and data?
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies want agentic AI to be the new way you shop. But should you trust AI when your money's involved?

breaking_news.headline: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

breaking_news.headline: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
breaking_news.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

breaking_news.headline: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
breaking_news.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

breaking_news.headline: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
breaking_news.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

breaking_news.headline: Famed ship SS United States to be sunk off coast of Florida
breaking_news.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

breaking_news.headline: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
breaking_news.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

breaking_news.headline: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
breaking_news.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

breaking_news.headline: New York building collapse kills one person and injures 12
breaking_news.summary: Rescuers are searching for people who may be trapped under the rubble of the three-story building in Brooklyn.

breaking_news.headline: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
breaking_news.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
breaking_news.summary: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

breaking_news.headline: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
breaking_news.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Sales of tinned food and bottled water  jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
breaking_news.summary: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.

breaking_news.headline: Claude chatbot maker set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
breaking_news.summary: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.

breaking_news.headline: From Paris to DC - why offices are being turned into apartments
breaking_news.summary: Office buildings with low occupancy rates are being transformed into flats.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
breaking_news.summary: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.
